title: SAGE-CP v5: code and results for worst-group coverage of conformal prediction under geographic shift (BRFSS, NHANES)
description: Code, notebooks and result summaries for the study 'Worst-group coverage of conformal prediction under geographic shift: an exact finite-sample reference and a component-wise evaluation in health survey data' (submitted to BMC Medical Research Methodology). Includes the analysis notebooks (v2.1 to v4.3) for internal-external validation across 54 U.S. jurisdictions of the raw BRFSS 2022, the temporal check on BRFSS 2023 and external validation on NHANES 2021-2023 (measured diabetes, hypertension and high cholesterol); survey-weighted calibration and randomised tie-breaking arms; the installable worst-group-reference Python module (exact and design-weighted finite-sample references and simulation-free bounds) with a worked example and tests; validation simulations; and scripts that regenerate the tables and figures and check every reported number. Source data are public (CDC BRFSS, NHANES, Kaggle) and not included.
